title: Editor Backend Core Live Compatibility Harness
summary: Completed the Editor-owned live compatibility harness: a loopback Backend HTTP server is seeded from the Core fixture, consumed through the real Editor backend client, migrated, mutated, and applied back into Editor runtime state; Editor owner gates passed on the worktree and merged main.
expectedOutput: An Editor-owned live integration test or a boundary blocker that distinguishes real Editor client to Backend server to Core semantic compatibility from mocked transport evidence, followed by Project Control evidence registration without broad map promotion.
riskSummary: The harness proves the Node loopback Editor client to Backend server to Core fixture path, but not a browser-app smoke, deployed Backend environment, broader document corpus, or production-readiness truth. Editor npm install reported existing high-severity audit findings and Vite retained the existing chunk-size warning; neither was remediated in this lane.
